Frequently Asked Questions

My Duncan home is only a few years old. Why schedule HVAC maintenance already?

Most manufacturer warranties require documented annual service to stay enforceable, and a tune-up verifies what the builder’s installer may not have, including refrigerant charge and airflow. Catching an installation shortcut in year two is far cheaper than discovering it in year eight.

What size standby generator does a typical Duncan house need?

It comes down to what you want powered during an outage. Essential circuits such as the refrigerator, some lighting, and the furnace need far less capacity than whole-home coverage that includes air conditioning. A load calculation during the estimate settles the size, and both tiers get priced.

How do I know if my water pressure problem is the house or the utility?

Pressure that is low at every fixture, hot and cold alike, points toward the supply side, the pressure reducing valve, or aging supply lines. Pressure that drops at one fixture or only on hot water points inside the house. A pressure assessment isolates the cause before any repair is quoted.

Does duct cleaning actually help with Upstate pollen?

It helps with the pollen already inside. Spring pollen that enters the house settles into duct runs and returns to circulation every time the blower starts, and cleaning removes that stored load. Keeping it out going forward is filtration’s job, so the two get evaluated together.

Which nearby communities do you serve?

Greer, Woodruff, and Taylors all sit inside regular coverage, along with the rest of the Greenville and Spartanburg area. The chat team can confirm any address in minutes.
